reconciliation_findings: The M-601 primary registry has 30 literal schedule rows. The six P-xA,B rows express paired marks but provide no source-stated serial-number expansion, so they remain six schedule identities in this ledger.
M-803 uses CP-1 through CP-4 in the chiller/primary-secondary matrix, while M-601 uses CP-1 through CP-6 as AHU circulators. The system/table scopes differ, so their tag text is not silently merged.
M-804/M-805 controller matrix tags restart by system. These logical/physical matrix circles are associated to their named system template, not reconciled to an unsupplied global field-device list.

The 157 M-601 laboratory air-valve application rows are all retained, including repeated room/service cases. They are air-valve scheduling data, not evidence of 157 actuators, controller points, or installed terminal quantities.

M-601's PRV schedule is pressure reducing valves (30 psi in / 25 psi out / 6 GPM). It is not a control-valve selection schedule. The sheets show dampers/motor-operated dampers but do not publish an actuator torque/model/signal/fail-action schedule.

control_valve_schedule.note: Sequences and diagrams show valve modulation, but no source table provides control-valve tag/Cv/actuator/signal/fail position.

damper_actuator_schedule.note: M-601 is an air-valve/air-device schedule; it provides no damper-actuator tag, manufacturer, torque, control signal, or fail position.
